title: Brand Manager
description:
About Yauna Wellness

Yauna Wellness is dedicated to helping people live healthier, more balanced lives through thoughtfully developed wellness products and experiences. We combine quality, trust, education, and customer-centric innovation to build meaningful relationships with our community.

Role Overview

Yauna Wellness is seeking a creative, analytical, and commercially minded Brand Manager to develop and strengthen our brand across all customer touchpoints. The Brand Manager will own brand positioning, marketing campaigns, product communication, content direction, partnerships, and performance analysis.

The ideal candidate understands wellness consumers, can translate insights into compelling campaigns, and is comfortable coordinating creative, digital, sales, product, and agency partners.

Key ResponsibilitiesBrand strategy

* Develop and execute Yauna Wellness’s brand strategy, positioning, messaging, and annual marketing calendar.
* Maintain a consistent brand identity, tone of voice, and customer experience across digital, retail, packaging, events, and partnerships.
* Monitor wellness, beauty, lifestyle, and consumer trends to identify opportunities for brand growth.
* Conduct competitor research and customer analysis to refine brand positioning.

Campaigns and content

* Plan and manage integrated campaigns across social media, digital advertising, email, influencers, public relations, retail, and offline channels.
* Create clear briefs for designers, content creators, agencies, photographers, and production partners.
* Oversee the development of campaign concepts, product stories, educational content, and promotional material.
* Review creative work to ensure it meets brand standards and commercial objectives.
* Coordinate the content calendar with social media and performance-marketing teams.

Product marketing

* Develop go-to-market plans for new products, collections, services, and wellness initiatives.
* Define product positioning, key benefits, customer messages, launch campaigns, and supporting sales material.
* Collaborate with product development, operations, and sales teams to ensure successful launches.
* Gather customer feedback and market insights to inform future product and packaging decisions.

Partnerships and community

* Identify and manage relationships with wellness experts, creators, influencers, ambassadors, studios, retailers, and strategic partners.
* Develop community-building initiatives that improve engagement, trust, and customer loyalty.
* Evaluate partnership opportunities based on brand alignment, audience quality, and commercial potential.
* Support events, workshops, activations, and experiential campaigns.

Performance and budget management

* Track brand health and campaign performance using agreed metrics.
* Manage the brand marketing budget and ensure effective allocation of resources.
* Analyse campaign results and recommend improvements based on customer response, engagement, conversion, and return on investment.
* Prepare regular performance reports and present insights to leadership.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, branding, or a related discipline.
* Three to six years of experience in brand management, consumer marketing, product marketing, or an equivalent role.
* Experience in wellness, health, beauty, personal care, lifestyle, nutrition, fitness, or consumer products is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, social media, content strategy, influencer marketing, and consumer behaviour.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong project-management skills with the ability to coordinate several initiatives simultaneously.
* Comfortable working with campaign data, budgets, and performance metrics.

Preferred Attributes

* Genuine interest in wellness and healthy living.
* Strong creative judgement combined with commercial awareness.
* Customer-focused and capable of turning consumer insights into effective brand initiatives.
* Collaborative, organised, proactive, and attentive to detail.
* Comfortable working in a growing, entrepreneurial environment.
* Able to balance long-term brand building with short-term revenue objectives.

Key Performance Indicators

Success in this role may be measured through:

* Brand awareness and customer consideration.
* Audience and community growth.
* Campaign engagement and conversion.
* New-product launch performance.
* Customer acquisition, retention, and repeat purchases.
* Influencer and partnership effectiveness.
* Website traffic and branded-search growth.
* Marketing return on investment.
* Consistency and quality of brand execution.

What Yauna Wellness Offers

* The opportunity to shape and grow an emerging wellness brand.
* A collaborative and purpose-driven working environment.
* Creative ownership and meaningful responsibility.
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
* Competitive compensation and benefits based on experience.
* Employee access to Yauna Wellness products and initiatives.

How to Apply

Please submit your résumé and a short note explaining your interest in Yauna Wellness. Candidates are encouraged to include examples of brand campaigns, product launches, content, or partnerships they have led.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

title: E-commerce Opretions Executive
description:
Job Description: E-Commerce Operations Executive

**Department:** Operations  
**Reports To:** Sr. E-Commerce Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Role Overview

The E-Commerce Operations Executive is responsible for the day-to-day management of online product listings, inventory, and order fulfillment, ensuring a smooth and efficient shopping experience across the company's online platforms. This role works cross-functionally to optimize website performance, monitor sales performance, and resolve operational issues that impact customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

**Product Listings & Catalog Management**

* Create, update, and maintain accurate product listings (titles, descriptions, images, pricing, categorization)
* Ensure product information is consistent and error-free across all sales channels
* Conduct regular audits of the product catalog to identify and fix discrepancies

**Inventory Management**

* Monitor stock levels and coordinate with warehouse/supply chain teams to prevent stockouts or overstocking
* Update inventory data across the website and any connected marketplaces in real time
* Forecast inventory needs based on sales trends and seasonal demand

**Order Fulfillment**

* Oversee the order processing cycle from placement to delivery
* Coordinate with logistics/courier partners to ensure timely and accurate shipments
* Track and resolve issues related to delayed, lost, or incorrect orders
* Manage returns, refunds, and exchanges in line with company policy

**Website Performance & Customer Experience**

* Collaborate with marketing, design, and IT/tech teams to improve site navigation, load speed, and checkout flow
* Identify and report bugs or usability issues affecting the customer journey
* Support A/B testing and UX improvement initiatives

**Sales Monitoring & Reporting**

* Track key metrics such as conversion rate, average order value, cart abandonment, and sales volume
* Prepare regular performance reports and share insights with management
* Identify trends and recommend action plans to improve sales performance

**Problem Resolution**

* Proactively identify operational bottlenecks (in listings, inventory, or fulfillment) and implement solutions
* Address escalated customer complaints related to orders or product issues
* Coordinate with customer support teams to ensure timely resolution

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Business, E-Commerce, Marketing, or a related field
* 1–3 years of experience in e-commerce operations, online retail, or a similar role
* Familiarity with e-commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce, Amazon Seller Central) and inventory management systems
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; experience with analytics tools (Google Analytics, etc.) is a plus
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Good communication and cross-team coordination abilities
* Analytical mindset with problem-solving skills

Key Skills

* Product listing & catalog management
* Inventory & order management
* Data analysis & reporting
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Customer-centric problem solving

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

title: Client Engagement Specialist
description:
**About the Team:**

At Dow Jones, we empower global organizations to navigate an increasingly volatile world, where geopolitical shifts, financial crime, regulatory expansion and emerging AI technologies redefine risk every day. Powered by market-leading intelligence capabilities—including Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, Dragonfly, Oxford Analytica, Storyful, Dow Jones Risk Journal, Factiva and Dow Jones Newswires—we deliver the trusted insights our customers need to build resilience, protect their reputations and make mission-critical decisions with confidence.

**About the Role:**

The Client Engagement Specialist (CES) is responsible for managing all renewal aspects of the relationship with a defined set of customers. The Client Engagement Specialist is responsible for retaining the existing contract revenue within existing buying centers and supporting new sales into these accounts made by the Business Development Managers.

To this end the Client Engagement Specialist will need to liaise with DJ internal teams to ensure the clients business needs are being met consistently to support the renewal. Ultimately the Client Engagement Specialist must develop and drive successful renewals ensuring a strong revenue base for Dow Jones.

Success will be measured based on the retention rates of the Client Engagement Specialists assigned accounts.

**You Will**

Retention

* Responsible for owning the retention strategy for assigned Strategic accounts by building and executing a renewal plan
* Proactively provide a clear picture to management by highlighting high risk renewal accounts and strategies to mitigate potential losses
* Responsible for ensuring appropriate levels of customer training and product utilization by working with the Product Training Specialist team and monitoring internal CRM reports
* Oversee the overall renewal lifecycle; from pricing and contracting alongside the Account Executive, to invoicing and client support, so customer concerns get addressed correctly and efficiently throughout the fiscal year
* Support new sales into existing accounts to ensure maximum customer ROI with DJ
* Support clients’s transitions from legacy tools to DJ upgrade platforms

Customer Knowledge

* Know your customer including the development of good account understanding, business groups deriving value from DJ services, understanding the clients’ business/industry, competitor solutions they are using and the client’s current and developing needs
* Understand how your clients derive value from DJ services/products, know the people involved including decision makers within those groups.
* Serve as a client conduit internally for feedback and competitive intelligence to DJ Product, Content & Marketing.

Lead Generation

* Where possible identify opportunities for increased revenue within the set of accounts (up-selling and possibly cross-selling) and work with other members of the sales team to follow through on such opportunities.

The CES must maintain accurate and appropriate client records within the Company’s systems. The CES will communicate with clients mainly via telephone and email.

**You Have**

* 2-4 years of proven success in client engagement, customer success or account management
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Other language proficiency is a strong plus
* Proven ability to multi-task and adhere to tight deadlines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
* Excellent project management and organizational skills with a keen attention to detail
* Proficient in Microsoft Office suite & Google Drive
* Knowledge of Salesforce & Tableau desirable

**Our Benefits**

* Comprehensive Insurance & Retirement plans
* Paid Time Off and Leaves
* Education Benefits
* Family Care Benefits
* Career Growth Programs
* Access to Dow Jones Products
* Employee Referral Program
* Employee Well-being Support & Fitness Programs
* Financial Health Programs
* Cybersecurity Protection

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.

Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.

We are looking for an AI-forward **Customer Success & Implementation Lead** to manage the complete post-sales journey for our enterprise customers—from contract handover and implementation to adoption, retention, and growth.

In this role, you will lead the Implementation and Onboarding team, drive successful enterprise deployments, and build scalable customer success processes. You will also use AI-powered development tools to prototype client requirements, automate workflows, analyse technical issues, and accelerate integrations without being completely dependent on the core engineering team.

#### **What will you do at Fynd?**

**Lead Implementation and Delivery**

* Lead and mentor a team of Implementation Managers and Onboarding Specialists.
* Own key implementation metrics, including time-to-go-live, catalog migration, deployment success, and user adoption.
* Manage the complete handover process from Sales to Implementation and Customer Success.
* Oversee the integration of store locations, ERPs, marketplaces, inventory systems, and supply chain workflows.
* Identify implementation risks, resolve delivery bottlenecks, and ensure projects are completed within committed timelines.
* Build scalable playbooks for onboarding, system configuration, customer training, escalation management, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).

**Drive AI-Assisted Technical Solutions**

* Use AI development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Bolt, Lovable, or similar platforms to build functional prototypes, front-end mock-ups, and custom widgets.
* Demonstrate client-specific use cases and Fynd API capabilities through working prototypes.
* Build scripts or lightweight applications to clean and transform retail catalog data, automate customer health scores, and improve onboarding workflows.
* Analyse API logs, JSON payloads, client-side code, and integration issues to identify potential root causes.
* Translate business and technical challenges into clear, actionable specifications for Product and Engineering teams.
* Use AI tools to reduce dependency on engineering teams for routine technical tasks and accelerate customer resolution timelines.

**Own Customer Retention and Growth**

* Build trusted relationships with CXOs, founders, e-commerce leaders, and senior stakeholders across enterprise accounts.
* Act as a strategic advisor and help customers achieve measurable business outcomes through Fynd’s solutions.
* Partner with Account Management and Sales teams to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across Fynd’s product portfolio.
* Own key commercial and customer success metrics, including renewals, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), adoption, and customer health.
* Conduct regular business reviews and proactively address risks that could affect customer satisfaction or retention.
* Consolidate customer feedback and share actionable insights with Product and Engineering teams to influence the product roadmap.

#### **What we're looking for**

* 6–10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Enterprise Implementation, Technical Account Management, or a related role.
* At least 2 years of experience leading an implementation, onboarding, customer success, or engineering-adjacent team.
* Strong experience in Retail Technology, E-commerce, Omnichannel Commerce, Order Management Systems, logistics, or supply chain platforms.
* Understanding of how storefronts, warehouses, ERPs, marketplaces, inventory systems, and physical stores work together.
* Hands-on experience using AI development tools to create functional code, prototypes, scripts, automations, or internal applications.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, databases, and basic data transformation.
* Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with experience managing complex enterprise implementations.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience managing senior stakeholders, including CXOs, founders, and e-commerce leaders.
* A metrics-driven approach with a proven record of improving onboarding timelines, customer adoption, retention, or NRR.
* Strong ownership, problem-solving, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**What do we offer?**

**Growth**

At Fynd, growth is limitless. We nurture a culture that encourages innovation, embraces challenges, and supports continuous learning. As we expand into new product lines and global markets, we’re seeking talented individuals eager to grow with us.

We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers.

* Learning Wallet: Enrol in external courses or certifications to upskill—we’ll reimburse the costs to support your development.

**Culture**

We believe in building strong teams and lasting connections.

* Regular community engagement and team-building activities
* Biannual events to celebrate achievements, foster collaboration, and strengthen our workplace culture

**Wellness**

Your well-being is our priority. Comprehensive Mediclaim policy for you, your spouse, children, and parents

**Work Environment**

We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.

Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!

title: Campaign & Channel Activation Manager
description:
**Your Role**
-------------


THE OPPORTUNITY Lead the disciplined translation of global brand strategy and campaign assets into compliant, locally relevant and measurable market activation across traditional, out\-of\-home and digital channels.
  

  

THE MANDATE Own end\-to\-end campaign mobilisation, readiness, execution, asset governance, optimisation and performance reporting, connecting global teams, markets, agencies, channel partners, technology, supply chain and customer service.


The Campaign \& Channel Activation Manager is accountable for planning, coordinating and delivering integrated brand and digital campaigns across channels. The role converts global campaign direction and approved assets into locally executable plans, ensuring that content, product, fulfilment, service, technology, measurement and compliance dependencies are ready before go\-live.


The role manages campaign work plans and cross\-functional delivery, oversees content and DAM governance, configures tracking and measurement, monitors live performance and runs optimisation sprints. It also supports markets through coaching and quality\-assurance clinics so that activation remains aligned with toolkits, guardrails and local requirements.


**In this role you will play a key role in:**
---------------------------------------------


**Campaign Activation Scope**
=============================


* Brand campaign activation across traditional and out\-of\-home channels using global assets.
* Digital campaign planning and execution across social, CRM, SEO, eCommerce and other owned or paid channels.
* Campaign mobilisation, work management, launch readiness and cross\-functional orchestration.
* Content adaptation, localisation, production coordination and lifecycle management.
* DAM upload, metadata, structured storage, quality validation, version control, archiving and utilisation reporting.
* Campaign objective setting, success criteria, tracking, performance analysis, insight generation and optimisation.
* In\-market coaching, quality\-assurance clinics and activation support.

**Key Accountabilities**
========================


**1\. Integrated Brand Campaign Execution**
-------------------------------------------


* Execute brand marketing campaigns across channels using approved global assets, translating campaign strategy into coordinated market activation plans.
* Adapt global assets to local formats, channel specifications and market requirements while protecting brand integrity and usage rights.
* Coordinate activation across traditional and out\-of\-home channels, aligning teams, agencies, media partners and delivery milestones.
* Monitor campaign delivery and address quality, timing or compliance risks against global guidelines.

**2\. Digital Campaign Planning and Mobilisation**
--------------------------------------------------


* Build and manage the campaign work plan, task breakdown, delivery cards, communications tracking and operating cadence through go\-live.
* Coordinate launch readiness across product data, stock validation, warehouse\-management\-system setup, fulfilment and customer\-service support, using applicable SAP information.
* Create integrated channel activation plans that clarify deliverables, owners, dependencies, approvals, hand\-offs and launch gates.
* Coordinate execution across markets, functional teams, agencies, platforms and channel partners.

**4\. Channel Activation and Lifecycle Communications**
-------------------------------------------------------


* Manage social media campaign execution and coordinate channel\-specific publishing, moderation and delivery requirements.
* Build and manage CRM campaign execution and lifecycle communications across email, SMS and push notifications.
* Execute SEO activities, including keyword research and optimisation with local SEO partners.
* Execute eCommerce campaign activations, pricing and promotional activities, and product launch campaigns in line with approved plans and controls.

**5\. Tracking, Measurement and Optimisation**
----------------------------------------------


* Define campaign objectives, document success criteria and translate them into measurable KPIs and channel\-level performance expectations.
* Configure campaign tracking, tagging and measurement requirements before launch and verify implementation readiness.
* Monitor live performance and run in\-flight optimisation sprints covering creative, audiences, targeting and bidding.
* Collect and analyse performance data, report campaign outcomes and generate practical insights and recommendations.
* Review and retire obsolete campaign data in line with applicable retention and governance requirements.

**7\. Market Enablement and Quality Assurance**
-----------------------------------------------


* Provide in\-market coaching and quality\-assurance clinics to align local activation plans with campaign toolkits and guardrails.
* Facilitate practical training sessions for campaign processes, tools, assets and channel requirements.
* Provide feedback, issue\-resolution support and recommendations that improve market readiness and execution quality.
**YOUR PROFILE**
----------------


* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience managing integrated marketing campaigns across traditional, OOH and digital channels within CPG / FMCG or a comparable regulated consumer environment.
* Proven capability to mobilise complex campaigns, coordinate cross\-functional launch readiness and manage delivery across markets, agencies, channel partners and technology platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of social, SEO, eCommerce, campaign tracking and performance optimisation.
* Demonstrated judgement in marketing compliance, stakeholder management, data\-led decision\-making and disciplined end\-to\-end campaign delivery.
* Strong campaign judgement with the ability to convert global direction into practical market execution.
* Structured programme management, with rigorous control of milestones, dependencies, risks and launch gates.
* Collaborative stakeholder leadership across global teams, markets, agencies, technology, supply chain and customer service.
* Commercial and performance orientation, using evidence to prioritise and optimise channel investment and execution.
* High standards of quality, compliance, asset governance and operational discipline.
* Calm, decisive problem\-solving in fast\-moving, multi\-market campaign environments.

Coaching mindset that builds market confidence and improves repeatable ways of working.


**Stakeholder Landscape**
=========================


Global and local Brand and Marketing teams; Digital, CRM, Social, SEO and eCommerce teams; Legal, Regulatory and Privacy; Data, Analytics and Technology; Supply Chain, SAP, WMS, Fulfilment and Customer Service; Sales and Commercial teams; Service Delivery Managers and Project Leads; creative, media, production, localisation and platform partners.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE**
---------------------------------------


* You can shape your career with us. We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini group. You will also get personalized career guidance from our leaders.
* You will get comprehensive wellness benefits including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top\-ups, elder care, partner coverage or new parent support via flexible work.
* You will have the opportunity to learn on one of the industry's largest digital learning platforms, with access to 250,000\+ courses and numerous certifications.
* We’re committed to ensure that people of all backgrounds feel encouraged and have a sense of belonging at Capgemini. You are valued for who you are, and you can bring your original self to work.
* Every Monday, kick off the week with a musical performance by our in\-house band \- The Rubber Band. Also get to participate in internal sports events, yoga challenges, or marathons.
* At Capgemini, you can work on cutting\-edge projects in tech and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.

description:
Role Overview  

**Job description**

 **Performance Marketing – Amplify**


Own paid growth for Amplify—from channel strategy and creative testing to media budgets, agency execution and acquisition economics.


Function


Growth / Marketing


Employment


Full\-time

**About Amplify**


Amplify is a consumer\-focused digital proposition designed to help people better understand credit, build financial awareness and make more informed financial decisions. As Amplify scales, performance marketing will be a critical growth engine—bringing the right users into the app efficiently, testing what drives engagement and building a repeatable acquisition model.

**Role purpose**


The Performance Marketing lead will own Amplify’s paid acquisition agenda end to end. This person will identify the right channels and audiences, translate growth objectives into campaign plans, manage agencies and media partners, shape performance\-oriented content and creative, control and optimise marketing budgets, and build a strong measurement discipline around user acquisition and conversion.

**What you will own**

* **Paid acquisition strategy:** Develop the paid\-growth strategy across relevant channels such as Google, Meta, YouTube, app\-install campaigns and other digital channels; determine the appropriate channel mix by audience, objective and stage of the funnel.
* **Campaign planning \& execution:** Translate business and growth goals into campaign calendars, media plans, audience strategies, test plans and execution briefs; ensure campaigns are launched accurately and on time.
* **Media budget ownership:** Build monthly/quarterly spend plans, allocate budgets across channels and campaigns, monitor pacing, forecast outcomes and recommend reallocation based on performance and marginal returns.
* **Agency \& partner management:** Act as the day\-to\-day owner for performance marketing agencies, media partners and specialised vendors; set briefs, review plans, challenge recommendations, track delivery and hold partners accountable for results.
* **Performance content \& creative:** Work with internal teams and agencies to create ad concepts, copy, videos, statics, landing\-page/app\-store messaging and campaign assets designed for acquisition. Build a structured creative\-testing cadence rather than relying on one\-off campaigns.

* Paid user acquisition volume against plan and within approved budgets.

* Quality of acquired users, including engagement/retention indicators where sufficient data is available.
* Budget pacing, forecast accuracy and disciplined reallocation of spend toward better\-performing campaigns.
* Creative testing velocity and measurable improvement from winning creatives/audiences/landing experiences.
* Channel\-level return measures such as ROAS or LTV:CAC where the business model and data maturity support them.
* Agency delivery quality, turnaround time, reporting accuracy and adherence to agreed performance targets.

**Experience \& background**

* Approximately 5–9 years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing or digital acquisition, with meaningful hands\-on ownership of paid media budgets.
* Experience managing campaigns across major digital advertising platforms; mobile\-app acquisition experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage agencies while still being close enough to the numbers to independently assess campaign quality and performance.

* Experience in a consumer\-tech, fintech, financial\-services, payments, lending, insurance, e\-commerce or subscription\-led business is preferred, but strong D2C growth experience from other sectors is also relevant.

title: Review Generation Team Lead & Community Manager
description:
**About HG**  

HG Insights is the pioneer of Revenue Growth Intelligence. For more than a decade, we have delivered comprehensive, AI\- driven datasets on B2B buyers, technology adoption, IT spend, and buyer intent, sourced from billions of data points.  

Today, we are a trusted partner to Fortune 500 technology companies, hyperscalers, and innovative B2B vendors seeking precise go\-to\-market analytics and decision\-  

making. Through an evolving suite of AI agents that incorporate first\-party data and buyer signals, HG Insights enables AI\-powered GTM automation across sales, marketing, RevOps, and data analytics teams, modernizing GTM execution from strategy through activation.

  


**About the Role**



As the Review Generation Team Lead \& Community Manager, you will own the strategy and execution of HG Insights' review generation program end\-to\-end. You will lead a team of campaign specialists and managers, set the direction for how we drive review submissions across our customer and enterprise base, and build a community of engaged reviewers who see ongoing value in participating. You'll partner closely with the Director of Leads, Content, and Research to align review generation with broader pipeline and content goals, and you'll use a data\-driven approach to guide the team's priorities and measure impact.


**What you'll do**


* Own the strategy, roadmap, and prioritization framework for all review generation efforts across product lines and customer segments.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for executing review campaigns, setting goals, and providing regular performance feedback.
* Partner with the Director of Leads, Content, and Research to align review generation priorities with pipeline, content, and research initiatives.
* Build and nurture a community of engaged reviewers and buyers, including recognition, incentive, and ambassador\-style programs that encourage repeat participation.
* Set team\-wide KPIs for review volume, quality, and velocity, and report on program performance to leadership.
* Work with the UGC team to ensure campaign content and messaging is consistent, compelling, and on\-brand across all review generation touchpoints.
* Partner with Customer Success and Enterprise stakeholders to prioritize campaigns based on renewal, expansion, and strategic account needs, including direct customer engagement when needed.
* Establish and maintain compliance standards across the team (CAN\-SPAM, GDPR, and other email regulations) and ensure best practices are followed consistently.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance through segmentation, personalization, and A/B testing, and ensure the team applies these consistently.
* Stay current on review platform trends, community management best practices, and email marketing innovations, bringing new ideas back to the team.


**What we are looking for**


* 5\+ years of experience in email marketing, community management, or a related field, including 1\-2\+ years in a people management or team lead role
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field
* Proven experience managing or mentoring a team, with the ability to set goals, coach, and evaluate performance
* Skilled in marketing automation platforms (e.g., Ortto, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud)
* Strong writing, editing, and content strategy skills
* Experience designing and prioritizing campaigns across multiple stakeholders and customer segments
* Data\-driven with the ability to translate campaign performance into team strategy
* Proficiency with CRM systems (such as Salesforce Data Cloud), and basic HTML, CSS, and/or Liquid
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, with experience working alongside directors or senior leadership
* Proficient in using AI tools to optimize workflows


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience specifically in review generation, UGC, or online community management
* Experience running reviewer recognition, loyalty, or ambassador programs
* Familiarity with review platforms
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers/clients, including presenting to and meeting with stakeholders
* Experience in lead generation tactics (such as LinkedIn Ads, sponsorships, events)
* Background in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology

  

  

**What we offer/Benefits**  

We take care of our people fully and genuinely. Every HG Insights employee receives comprehensive healthcare coverage for themselves and their families, a monthly wellness reimbursement and access to Able To professional mental health coaching for stress, anxiety and depression support as per the regions. For your financial future, US  

employees benefit from a 401(k) with up to 5% company matching and all UK employees are enrolled in a pension scheme. Every employee also receives stock options because the people who build this company should share in its success.  

We invest in your growth through an annual learning reimbursement and a genuine commitment to developing your career at every stage. And through our Culture Club,  

you will always have a real voice in shaping the kind of workplace we build together.

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  

HG Insights is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the event of a  

recruiter or agency submitting a resume or candidate without a signed agreement being in place, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire such candidates without any  

financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of HG Insights.

Manager, Product Development \- Network Products

Product development experience

Problem solving and pragmatic mindset, analytical skills, attention to documentation.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Cochlear is the global market leader in implant hearing solutions. Cochlear's mission is to help people hear and be heard. Around the world, more people chose a Cochlear\-branded hearing implant system than any other. A Cochlear Implant is an electronic device that is surgically implanted under the skin near the ear that restores hearing to those who suffer from severe hearing loss. It’s an incredible piece of engineering and the only product in the world that restores a sense through technology. Imagine using your experience to help people around the world to hear again. Our mission is to help more people to hear.


**Position Overview:**
----------------------

  

At Cochlear, we're passionate about helping people connect to a world of sound. Every day, our technology transforms lives, and our marketing team plays a critical role in ensuring more people become aware of the life\-changing benefits of hearing solutions.  



  

We're looking for an experienced **Digital Marketing Manager** to lead consumer marketing and demand generation across South Asia. This is an **individual contributor role** and an exciting opportunity for a strategic and commercially minded marketer who thrives on combining data, creativity, customer insights, and digital innovation to drive measurable business outcomes.  



  

**What You'll Be Doing:**
-------------------------

  

In this role, you'll own the development and execution of integrated, multi\-channel marketing campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, lead generation, and ultimately help more people access hearing healthcare.  



  

**Accountability 1: Lead Consumer Marketing Campaigns**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Develop and deliver integrated marketing campaigns that help achieve business objectives and drive consumer demand.
* Work closely with agencies to create media plans, PR initiatives, and localised campaign assets.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Concierge teams to create customer\-focused campaigns and materials that support lead generation and conversion.
* Collaborate with Professional Marketing to ensure consumer and professional communications are aligned and consistent.
* Work with APAC and Global teams to optimise website content, social media, email marketing, search marketing, and digital experiences.
* Support market research activities to better understand customers, market trends, and campaign performance.
* Develop marketing collateral that aligns with Cochlear's brand guidelines and customer needs.
* Act as the digital brand guardian, ensuring all marketing communications are consistent, relevant, and up to date.
Manage campaign budgets and deliver activities on time and within budget.  
* 

  

**Accountability 2: Drive Demand Generation and Digital Performance**
---------------------------------------------------------------------

* Lead digital demand generation programs that deliver high\-quality leads and contribute to business growth.
* Manage agency partners and monitor campaign performance, including lead volume, conversion rates, and cost per lead.
* Ensure campaigns are executed effectively, on schedule, and in line with agreed budgets.
* Plan and manage Cochlear India's social media content calendar to strengthen brand awareness and engagement.
* Monitor and respond to social media enquiries in a timely and professional manner.
Partner with APAC and Global marketing teams to localise and amplify regional campaigns through social media and digital channels.  
* 

  

**Accountability 3: Deliver Lead Generation Targets**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Drive achievement of monthly and quarterly Sales Accepted Lead (SAL) targets through digital marketing initiatives.
* Monitor performance throughout the customer journey, including conversion from lead to surgery.
* Provide regular reporting and insights to local leadership and APAC stakeholders.
Identify risks and opportunities early and recommend actions to improve results and campaign performance.  
* 

  

**Accountability 4: Reporting, Insights and Continuous Improvement**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

* Monitor, analyse, and optimise campaign performance across all digital channels.
* Define key performance indicators and provide clear reporting, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Partner with APAC and Global analytics teams to understand lead generation and conversion trends.
* Use customer, market, competitor, and campaign data to identify opportunities for growth and improvement.
* Manage the digital marketing budget and ensure a strong return on investment.
* Contribute to annual marketing planning by developing consumer marketing strategies and activity plans aligned with business objectives.
* Continuously test, learn, and optimise campaigns to improve customer engagement and business outcomes.

**What We're Looking For:**
---------------------------

We're seeking a digital marketer who combines strategic thinking with strong execution capability.  



  

You will bring:


* 5\-10 years of experience in digital marketing, demand generation, consumer marketing, or brand management
* Proven success developing and delivering data\-driven campaigns that generate measurable business outcomes
* Strong understanding of digital channels including paid media, SEM, social media, website optimisation, email marketing, and marketing automation
* Experience working with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce and Marketo
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to turn insights into action
* Experience managing agency partners, budgets, and campaign performance
* Postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Business, or a related field
* **Willingness to travel across India (up to 50% of the time)**

  

**Why Join Cochlear?**
----------------------

At Cochlear, you'll do more than build marketing campaigns.


You'll help create awareness of technology that can genuinely change lives.


We offer:


 Purpose\-driven work that helps people hear and connect with the world around them


 Opportunities to work with regional and global teams


 Exposure to sophisticated digital marketing, marketing automation, and customer engagement strategies


 A collaborative, innovative, and mission\-led culture  



  

**Ready to Make an Impact?**
----------------------------

If you're passionate about digital marketing, customer engagement, data\-driven decision making, and creating campaigns that make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.


**Join Cochlear and help us bring the gift of hearing to more people across South Asia.**

Cochlear’s mission is to help people hear and be heard. As the global leader in implantable hearing solutions, Cochlear is dedicated to helping people with moderate to profound hearing loss experience a life full of hearing. We aim to give people the best lifelong hearing experience and access to innovative future technologies. We collaborate with the industry’s best clinical, research and support networks. That’s why more people choose Cochlear than any other hearing implant company. Learn and grow with us as we tackle the most complex challenges in helping more people to hear and experience life’s opportunities.


If you feel that you have the skills and experience to be successful in this role and take on new challenges to build your career with Cochlear, please start your application by clicking the apply button


\#CochlearCareers


**How we recognise your contribution**

We want Cochlear to be a place where our people truly enjoy coming to work. Through our internal programs and employee benefits, we aim to create an environment where our people will feel value and supported. Whether your focus is on continuous learning, professional development or simply finding an environment which enables you to thrive whilst balancing family or personal life commitments, then we have several programs in place to support you.


At Cochlear we value and welcome the unique contributions, perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds of our employees and aim to build a culture that celebrates and leverages these differences, creating a sense of belonging and enabling our people to realise their full potential.

title: Marketing Operations Associate I
description:
**Our Mission**

  


You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you're blocked.


We're here to give power to the patient.



For nearly 20 years, we've built the leading healthcare marketplace \- helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we're going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc's marketplace topower access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.



Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from *seeking* to *getting*. We don't want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.



Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

  


**Your Impact on Our Mission:**



As a Marketing Operations Associate (Level 1\), you will play a crucial role in driving our mission by managing and executing operational workflows across product and acquisition marketing (Patient CRM, lead conversion, offline campaigns). You'll partner cross\-functionally to scope requirements, deliver ad hoc to long\-term projects, and document workflows. Your diligent research and data management efforts will directly enhance the accessibility and quality of healthcare information, empowering patients and providers alike with the resources they need to make informed decisions.


**You'll Enjoy This Role if You…**


* Are a confident, adaptive learner who ramps quickly and brings fresh, test‑and‑learn approaches to in‑flight projects.
* Are meticulous in planning and execution, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to juggle multiple stakeholders and projects without sacrificing quality or deadlines.

* Thrive in a fast‑paced, constantly evolving environment and operate in the sweet spot between structure, independence, and improvisation.

* Conduct thorough data verification through both structured and unstructured research to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* Meet or exceed defined performance metrics for productivity and accuracy, maintaining clear logs and dashboards where applicable.

**You'd be Successful in This Role if You Have…**

* Familiarity with MS Excel, MS Word, and AI‑driven tools (e.g., ChatGPT, other LLMs), plus strong web research techniques.
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

title: Technical Lead
description:
We are looking for a hands\-on Technical Head who can take ownership of our overall technology and development function.

The person will be responsible for overseeing ongoing development, reviewing technical implementation, solving complex integration requirements, building APIs and webhooks, managing server and cloud infrastructure, and ensuring that all technology systems work reliably with our marketing, CRM, analytics, and third\-party platforms.

This is not a purely managerial role. The ideal candidate should be technically strong enough to understand, review, troubleshoot, design, and implement solutions independently when required.

The candidate should have strong experience with APIs, webhooks, server\-side integrations, cloud infrastructure, databases, CRM integrations, marketing APIs, conversion tracking, CAPI, offline conversions, and automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Development \& Technical Oversight

\- Oversee the development team and monitor the progress and quality of ongoing projects.

\- Review technical architecture, code quality, development practices, and implementation.

\- Understand existing applications, websites, dashboards, portals, and backend systems.

\- Identify technical issues and provide practical solutions.

\- Review developers' work and ensure projects are delivered according to requirements.

\- Take ownership of critical technical tasks when the development team requires support.

\- Ensure proper documentation of APIs, integrations, architecture, credentials, environments, and deployment processes.

\- Establish technical standards and best practices across projects.

2\. API Development \& Integration

\- Design, develop, integrate, and maintain REST APIs and other required APIs.

\- Create APIs based on business, product, CRM, and marketing requirements.

\- Develop and manage webhooks for real\-time data transfer and event\-based communication.

\- Integrate third\-party APIs, SaaS platforms, CRMs, payment systems, analytics platforms, and marketing platforms.

\- Handle authentication methods such as API keys, OAuth, tokens, JWT, etc.

\- Understand API request/response structures, JSON, HTTP methods, status codes, authentication, rate limits, and error handling.

\- Troubleshoot failed API calls, data mismatches, authentication issues, and integration failures.

\- Build middleware or backend services where required to connect multiple platforms.

3\. Marketing Technology \& Tracking Integrations

A strong understanding of MarTech and performance marketing integrations is mandatory.

The candidate should be able to work closely with the marketing and performance marketing teams to implement and troubleshoot:

\- Meta Conversions API (CAPI)

\- Meta Pixel

\- Google Ads Conversion Tracking

\- Google Ads Offline Conversion Tracking

\- Google Ads API / Data Manager integrations

\- Google Analytics 4

\- Google Tag Manager

\- CRM integrations

\- Lead tracking and lead lifecycle integrations

\- Click ID tracking such as GCLID, FBCLID and other attribution parameters

\- UTM tracking

\- Server\-side tracking

\- Web\-to\-CRM integrations

\- CRM\-to\-ad\-platform integrations

\- Conversion and event APIs

\- Postback integrations

\- S2S tracking

\- Affiliate tracking integrations

\- Webhook\-based lead and conversion transfer

\- Offline conversion uploads

\- Lead status and revenue/value feedback to advertising platforms

The candidate should understand how a lead moves from:

Ad → Landing Page → Tracking → CRM → Sales/Conversion → Revenue → Marketing Platform

and should be able to build or troubleshoot the technical infrastructure required at each stage.

4\. CRM \& Data Integrations

\- Integrate websites, landing pages, CRM systems, marketing platforms, and internal systems.

\- Build APIs and webhooks for lead creation, lead updates, status changes, and conversion events.

\- Ensure accurate transfer of lead information between systems.

\- Maintain unique identifiers and event IDs to prevent duplicate conversions.

\- Build systems for passing revenue, transaction, deposit, purchase, or other conversion values back to advertising platforms.

\- Work with marketing teams to ensure accurate attribution and reporting.

5\. Server \& Cloud Infrastructure

\- Manage and understand server environments and cloud infrastructure.

\- Work with platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Cloudflare, or equivalent infrastructure.

\- Understand domains, DNS, SSL, CDN, hosting, databases, storage, networking, and server configuration.

\- Manage application deployment and production environments.

\- Monitor server performance, uptime, logs, errors, and resource utilization.

\- Troubleshoot server\-side issues affecting websites, APIs, applications, and integrations.

\- Implement appropriate security measures for APIs and backend systems.

\- Work with developers and external infrastructure teams when required.

6\. Database \& Backend

\- Strong understanding of backend architecture and databases.

\- Work with SQL and/or NoSQL databases.

\- Understand database structures, relationships, queries, indexing, and data integrity.

\- Ensure reliable storage and transfer of lead, customer, transaction, and conversion data.

\- Troubleshoot database\-related issues and performance problems.

\- Design appropriate data structures for API and integration requirements.

7\. Technical Problem Solving

\- Act as the escalation point for complex technical issues.

\- Diagnose problems across frontend, backend, APIs, servers, databases, and third\-party platforms.

\- Identify whether an issue is related to code, server configuration, API, tracking, CRM, cloud infrastructure, or third\-party systems.

\- Work with developers to resolve bugs and production issues quickly.

\- Take ownership of technical incidents until resolution.

8\. Technology Planning \& Architecture

\- Evaluate existing technology infrastructure and recommend improvements.

\- Design scalable technical solutions for new projects.

\- Select appropriate technologies, APIs, services, and infrastructure based on project requirements.

\- Review third\-party tools before implementation.

\- Ensure systems are scalable, secure, maintainable, and properly documented.

\- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive technical and operational processes.

Required Technical Skills

Backend \& APIs

\- REST APIs

\- API development and integration

\- Webhooks

\- JSON

\- HTTP/HTTPS

\- OAuth 2\.0

\- JWT / API authentication

\- API security

\- Error handling and logging

Programming

Strong hands\-on knowledge of at least one backend language/framework, such as:

\- Node.js / Express

\- PHP / Laravel

Knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript would be an advantage.

Marketing Technology

\- CRM integrations

\- Server\-side tracking

\- S2S integrations

Integration Experience

Experience integrating platforms such as:

\- CRMs

\- Marketing automation platforms

\- Payment gateways

\- Analytics platforms

\- Advertising platforms

\- Affiliate networks

\- Lead management systems

\- WhatsApp / communication APIs

\- Internal business applications

\- Third\-party SaaS platforms

Leadership Responsibilities

\- Allocate technical tasks and monitor delivery.

\- Review development timelines and identify bottlenecks.

\- Conduct technical reviews of major projects.

\- Ensure developers follow proper coding, deployment, security, and documentation practices.

\- Convert business requirements into practical technical solutions.

\- Work with external developers, vendors, and technology partners when required.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is someone who can both manage technology and get their hands dirty technically.

You should be comfortable going from a business requirement such as:

«"We need every qualified lead from the CRM to be sent back to Meta and Google with the correct campaign, click ID, lead status, and conversion value."»

to understanding exactly:

Where the data originates → how it is stored → which API/webhook is required → how authentication works → how the data is transformed → how it is sent → how errors are handled → how the conversion is verified.

Similarly, if a developer says an integration cannot be completed because "the API isn't working," you should be able to investigate the API documentation, inspect requests/responses and logs, identify the actual problem, and guide or implement the solution.

**Qualifications**

\- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred.

\- 6\+ years of relevant technical experience.

We are looking for a Technical Head who can own the complete technical ecosystem, from development and APIs to servers, cloud infrastructure, CRM, marketing integrations, tracking, and automation.

The person should be a technical problem solver first and a team manager second, with the ability to understand business requirements, architect the solution, guide developers, and personally implement critical integrations when required.

At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

Kaseya is seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer – DevTest / QA Automation to design, build, and maintain robust automated testing capabilities across enterprise software platforms.



This is a hands\-on software engineering role focused on test automation and engineering quality. The ideal candidate will have a strong programming background and be capable of building test libraries, automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and large scale automated test suites.

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks, test libraries, utilities, and reusable automation components.

* Analyze existing application codebases and rapidly identify opportunities for automated test coverage.
* Develop and execute large\-scale automation initiatives capable of delivering hundreds of automated test cases in a short timeframe.

* Validate AI\-generated code and test cases through appropriate engineering practices, including code review, execution, debugging, and test\-result analysis.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and test execution infrastructure.
* Work with CI/CD runners, build systems, deployment pipelines, test environments, and automation reporting.

* Review application and test code and provide technical feedback on quality, maintainability, reliability, and automation effectiveness.
* Continuously improve automation speed, stability, coverage, and execution efficiency.

* Programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, C\#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar.

* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object\-oriented programming, data structures, APIs, databases, debugging, and version control.
* Experience developing automated tests for APIs, backend services, web applications, distributed systems, or enterprise software.
* Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution, including familiarity with CI/CD runners and build/deployment infrastructure.

Sales \& Revenue Growth* Monitor and drive Area revenue performance to achieve targeted sales growth and profitability.
* Evaluate the profitability of key accounts and take corrective measures to achieve profit targets.
* Track product\-wise yields regularly and develop action plans to meet set targets.
* Manage the end\-to\-end sales process for the Area, ensuring revenue growth for all products.


Channel Partner \& Customer Management* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers, ensuring revenue retention.
* Identify and drive new business opportunities through channel partners.
* Monitor and enhance channel partner performance in terms of revenue, sales, and profitability.
* Support sales capability\-building initiatives for sales teams and channel partners.


Sales Operations \& Compliance* Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) among sales teams and channel partners.
* Implement sales and marketing strategies to enhance market share and profitability.
* Follow up and ensure closure of product\-specific sales leads received from telemarketing or other departments.
* Negotiate rates and service offerings with customers within set approval limits.
* Maintain and update prospect details in the Saffire system on a daily basis.
* Address and resolve customer service issues in coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
* Provide insights to the Branch Sales Head regarding modifications to existing product offerings to enhance revenue and profitability.


Collection \& Remittance* Ensure achievement of collection targets within the set remittance cycle and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) benchmarks.


People Management* Guide and support the sales team to ensure high performance and goal alignment.
* Ensure optimal staffing levels within the Area sales team.

Education:* Essential: Graduate degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
* Preferred: An MBA or Postgraduate degree in Sales \& Marketing.


Experience:* 1\-3 years of experience in sales, business development, or key account management in the logistics, courier, supply chain, or e\-commerce industry.
* Experience in B2B sales, managing channel partners, and driving revenue growth is an added advantage.


Skills \& Capabilities:
Technical Skills:* Strong understanding of sales processes, revenue management, and market expansion strategies.
* Experience in logistics, courier services, or supply chain management.
* Proficiency in using sales tracking tools like Saffire and Avature.
* Knowledge of data analytics and business intelligence tools for tracking sales trends and performance.


Key Competencies:* Result\-Oriented: Strong drive to achieve sales targets and revenue growth.
* Customer\-Centric: Ability to develop and maintain strong customer relationships.
* Analytical Thinking: Proactive approach to market analysis and business development.
* Negotiation \& Influence: Strong persuasion skills to drive sales and revenue enhancement.

title: Manager, Product Management
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Manager, Product Management
Overview  

  

Mastercard Merchant Cloud and Acceptance represent core strategic priorities for the Asia Pacific region. Our mission is to empower acquirers, merchants, payment service providers (PSPs), and payment facilitators by delivering seamless, best\-in\-class experiences across both digital and in\-person commerce. We aim to position Mastercard Merchant Cloud as the leading platform for acceptance.  

As an integral part of Mastercard’s regional growth strategy, this role will support sales initiatives across Asia Pacific. Key responsibilities include conducting market research and benchmarking, contributing to go\-to\-market planning, supporting solution commercialization, and engaging in client\-related activities. The individual will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams—including Product, Operations, Delivery, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, and other internal partners—to drive execution and deliver strategic outcomes.  

  

Role  

  

* Support the identification and assessment of potential opportunities for Merchant Cloud across APAC through data analysis and insight generation.
* Conduct customer segmentation and lifecycle analysis to identify indicators of expansion, cross\-sell, or product adoption potential
* Analyze transaction characteristics and market data to support identification of relevant customer segments
* Develop and maintain analytical frameworks and reporting models including opportunity sizing approaches, funnel and conversion analytics, and pipeline coverage metrics for internal monitoring and decision\-support purposes.
* Build and maintain integrated analytical datasets and internal insight packs by combining data sources for internal analysis.
* Integrate diverse data inputs to generate analytical insights and structured outputs that may indicate high\-potential customers segments and support internal prioritization discussions.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to provide analytical support and validate data assumptions; does not involve participation in commercial decision\-making or execution.
* Provide data backed insights, benchmarking and analytical inputs to support value propositions by relevant team, ensuring Mastercard’s differentiation in the Merchant Cloud and Acceptance space.
* Analyse client trends and develop reports and dashboards to provide visibility and support internal decision\-making and performance monitoring.
* Partner with internal technology and core payments teams to support pipeline generation through various data sources, reporting and opportunity sizing models.

  

All About You  

  

* Experience in payments, fintech, or e\-commerce in APAC, ideally with exposure to acquirers, PSPs, merchants, or acceptance ecosystems.
* Strong data analysis capability, including advanced Excel (mandatory) and Tableau or Power BI (preferred).
* Proven ability to work with multi\-source datasets and synthesize them into clear, practical outputs.
* Experience supporting multi\-market proposition launches, including pipeline dashboards, account\-level analysis, and business insights that inform commercial decision\-making.
* Ability to translate data into simple, compelling narratives for non\-technical stakeholders.
* High ownership mindset, self\-starter mentality, and strong problem\-solving skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and the ability to create structure within a matrix organization.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Assistant Manager, Agentic Search
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**  

The “Insights and Analytics” organization within General Mills’ Strategy and Growth function is responsible to deliver integrated consumer, customer, category, and business performance insights to power smarter, faster decisions and next\-best actions, enabling precision in brand strategies, campaign execution, media and investment optimization across our US businesses and brands. The Insights and Analytics org has integrated teams operating from our Minneapolis and India offices. This is a newly created agentic AI role within our HQ Marketing Operations – Digital Transformation org, and will be based in our India office.  



As the Agentic Search \- Assistant Manager, you will be a key part of General Mills’ Marketing Activation and Operations team, helping translate real\-time data signals into prioritized actions that improve the visibility, accuracy and representation of our brands in leading AI systems. This role will sit at the intersection of data and insight generation, with a focus on interpreting regular outputs from LLM (large language model) optimization partners and converting those outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for the broader AEO (answer engine optimization) team. You will regularly receive and analyze data from third\-party vendors, identify what the results mean for content, help inform optimization decisions, map the phasing of recommended actions, and coordinate implementation with cross\-functional partners. In addition, you will be directly responsible for hiring, mentoring, and coaching another Agentic AI Analyst, who will be reporting to you. As a thought leader, you will be building cross\-functional relationships, and working across marketing, content, and operations teams to bring in key insights that are actionable and help us show up in the agentic results.


This role is ideal for a highly curious, detail\-oriented analyst who enjoys working through complex datasets, finding the story in the data, and helping teams move from insight to action.


Based in the General Mills India Center (GIC), this role will operate as part of General Mills’ global model, with day\-to\-day work direction and priorities closely connected to U.S.\-based functional partners and managers.  

  



**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

  

* **Data Analysis \& Performance Diagnostics:** Analyze large, nuanced datasets from LLM optimization platforms to diagnose what is working, what is not, and where search visibility can be improved.
* **Market \& Competitor Trend Tracking:** Maintain a proactive external view of relevant digital topics, retailer landscapes, and competitor movements to surface emerging generative search trends for internal teams.
* **Strategic Planning \& Prioritization:** Translate complex, rapidly evolving AI engine outputs into prioritized, phased optimization plans that focus resources on the highest\-value business opportunities.
* **Cross\-Functional Implementation:** Coordinate closely with cross\-functional partners to support the accurate, timely execution of approved optimization initiatives.
* **Stakeholder Reporting \& Capability Building:** Track optimization outcomes, maintain organized reporting, and surface risks and follow\-up opportunities to stakeholders while documenting learnings to refine the team's analytical approach over time.
* **Global Operating Model Support:** Enable a consistent, scalable way of working between U.S.\- and India\-based teams through proactive communication, strong organization, and clear documentation.
* **Pillar Leadership:** Build a high performing Agentic Analysis team in GIC, as an extension on the US Marketing Operations – Digital Transformation team. This involves both building the team, being responsible for deliverables – learning, context and acumen, and building capabilities/tools that may be required for the pillar.
* **Influence and Stakeholder Management:** Effectively communicate and provide leadership in meetings, influence decision making by proactively reaching out to stakeholders, ensuring timelines are met, meetings are productive and priorities are met timely.
* Mentor and coach the associate in India on best practices and remove roadblocks if any, with support from your manager
* Facilitate collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the larger Agentic Search team
Stay current on industry trends and consumer behavior insights, applying knowledge to refine and inform AI search optimization strategies.  
* 

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Computer Science, IT, Data Analytics, or a related field, with an MBA in Marketing / International Business.
* 4–6 years of experience in SEO, organic search, content optimization or digital marketing, with 2\+ years in AI Marketing Agents, AI Search Optimization, AEO, GEO or LLM\-based search.

Proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel, Navigating Tableau dashboards, R/SQL a plus

title: Control Manager - Program - Controls Room - Program Management & Governance Vice President
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

The Controls Room Team within Control Management works collaboratively with other control disciplines and oversees existing control functions as well as the development of new control functions and protocols. The team's objective is to empower the three lines of defense with risk\-based information to manage their control environment. We achieve this by collecting, analyzing, and monitoring firmwide risk\-based intelligence across all lines of business and corporate functions. As a Control Manager Program Vice President, you will be a key member of the team, leading cross\-functional delivery for firmwide programs that impact Control Management.


As a Control Manager Program Vice President within the Controls Room organization, you will translate enterprise requirements into executable project strategies, integrated roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. You will serve as a senior delivery and governance leader, aligning stakeholders across lines of business, product, and technology; proactively identifying and mitigating delivery, operational, and control risks; and driving disciplined execution against milestones, quality standards, and service\-level agreements.


You will also own User Acceptance Testing governance for in\-scope programs by establishing the UAT strategy, readiness standards, entry and exit criteria, and consolidated reporting. Working across business and technology teams, you will ensure end\-to\-end testing is appropriately planned, staffed, and executed, and that UAT scope, defects, and results remain aligned with program objectives and control effectiveness outcomes. Join our collaborative, high\-impact team and help strengthen how Control Management delivers complex firmwide change.

**Job responsibilities**

* Lead multiple concurrent firmwide application development projects end\-to\-end, ensuring roadmap creation and delivery predictability, stakeholder alignment, and execution against commitments, milestones, and SLAs
* Establish and run governance forums (steerco, working groups, executive readouts), define decision rights, manage RAID, and enforce standards for roadmap, scope, schedule, and quality
* Partner with firmwide program owners to translate requirements into actionable plans, ensuring full traceability from commitments to deliverables, testing evidence, and outcomes
* Proactively identify delivery, operational, and control risks; drive mitigations; ensure timely escalation; and partner with Control Management stakeholders to strengthen control outcomes at scale
* Lead change management for program requirements, influencing senior stakeholders and evolving operating models/processes to embed sustainable ways of working
* Define UAT governance framework, readiness checkpoints, entry/exit criteria, and reporting; oversee UAT planning and execution across teams; ensure defects are managed with appropriate accountability and sign\-off
