title: Tendering Manager – EHV Substations
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day (Tendering Manager – HV/EHV AIS \& GIS Substation Projects)  

As the Tendering Manager – HV/EHV AIS \& GIS Substation Projects, you will lead the end\-to\-end tendering and bid management activities for High Voltage (HV) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) substation projects, transmission and distribution infrastructure, EPC packages, and related power system solutions. You will be responsible for identifying business opportunities, developing winning bid strategies, managing techno\-commercial proposals, and ensuring competitive positioning across utility and private sector markets.  

In this leadership role, you will collaborate closely with engineering, procurement, project management, finance, legal, and supply chain teams to deliver high\-quality and profitable bids. You will engage with customers, utilities, consultants, and EPC partners while leveraging market intelligence, risk assessment, and pricing strategies to maximize business success. We are looking for an experienced tendering professional with deep expertise in AIS/GIS substations, power infrastructure projects, and business acquisition who can combine technical knowledge, commercial acumen, and market insight to drive sustainable growth and successful project acquisitions.  

How You'll Make an Impact* Drive business growth by identifying and evaluating tender opportunities across HV/EHV AIS \& GIS substations, transmission lines, switchyards, EPC projects, and power infrastructure developments.

* Monitor utility tenders, government procurement portals, private sector RFQs, and emerging market opportunities to support strategic business expansion.

* Lead bid/no\-bid evaluations by assessing project viability, competitive landscape, risk profiles, customer requirements, and organizational capabilities.

* Build and strengthen relationships with utilities, consultants, EPC partners, renewable developers, industrial customers, and key industry stakeholders.

* Lead the complete tendering lifecycle from opportunity identification through bid submission and contract award.

* Review tender documents, technical specifications, BOQs, drawings, contractual conditions, and commercial requirements to ensure comprehensive bid compliance.

* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including engineering, procurement, finance, legal, projects, and supply chain functions for successful bid preparation.

* Develop and submit technical proposals, commercial offers, prequalification documents, and supporting credentials in line with customer requirements.

* Conduct detailed techno\-commercial assessments, evaluating project scope, engineering solutions, execution methodologies, delivery schedules, and resource requirements.

* Identify project risks, commercial exposures, contractual deviations, and mitigation strategies to protect business interests.

* Prepare management approval notes, bid strategy documents, and executive summaries to support informed decision\-making.

* Develop competitive project costing models, pricing strategies, and profitability assessments while maintaining strong win probability.

* Perform market intelligence studies, competitor benchmarking, pricing analysis, and commodity trend assessments to strengthen bid competitiveness.

* Coordinate with vendors, OEMs, and suppliers to obtain optimized quotations, technical inputs, and commercial support.

* Prepare project cash\-flow analyses, margin evaluations, and business case assessments to support commercial decision\-making.

* Analyze transmission, distribution, renewable integration, AIS/GIS technology, and utility investment trends to support strategic growth initiatives.

* Maintain bid databases, pricing benchmarks, and competitive intelligence repositories to enhance future tendering effectiveness.

* Conduct customer meetings, technical discussions, pre\-bid clarifications, and tender negotiations to position Siemens Energy as a preferred partner.

* Participate in site visits for scope validation, feasibility assessment, logistics evaluation, constructability reviews, and risk identification.

* Review contractual terms and conditions, identify commercial and contractual risks, and recommend negotiation strategies and risk mitigation measures.

* Support post\-tender activities including customer clarifications, techno\-commercial discussions, contract finalization, and project handover to execution teams.

* Drive lessons learned and post\-bid reviews to continuously improve bid quality, competitiveness, and business acquisition success rates.

  

What You Bring* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (B.E./B.Tech).

* MBA in Marketing, Operations, Finance, or a related discipline is preferred.

* 12\-20 years of professional experience in tendering, estimation, proposal engineering, business acquisition, or bid management within the power sector.

* Minimum 8\-10 years of experience specifically focused on HV/EHV AIS and GIS substation projects.

* Strong expertise in AIS substations up to 765 kV and GIS substations up to 400 kV/765 kV.

* Deep understanding of transmission line projects, switchyards, EPC contracting, and power system infrastructure projects.

* Strong knowledge of protection and control systems, power transformers, reactors, HV switchgear, GIS equipment, SCADA, SAS, and communication systems.

* Proven experience managing tenders for utility customers including PGCIL, State Utilities, SEBs, DISCOMs, Railways, Metro projects, and other government entities.

* Demonstrated experience in bidding for private sector customers including industrial facilities, renewable energy developers, data centers, oil \& gas companies, and commercial infrastructure projects.

* Strong understanding of utility tendering procedures, contractual frameworks, project execution models, and regulatory requirements.

* Expertise in project costing, pricing strategy development, margin optimization, and financial risk assessment.

* Experience conducting competitor analysis, market intelligence studies, benchmark assessments, and business opportunity evaluations.

* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance competitiveness, profitability, and project execution risks.

* Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders across all organizational levels.

* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem\-solving skills with a customer\-centric approach.

* Proven experience working within cross\-functional, multicultural, and matrix organizations.

* Professional proficiency in English with excellent verbal, written, presentation, and business communication skills.

* Willingness to travel as required for customer meetings, site assessments, bid discussions, and business development activities.

title: Social Media Strategist + Copywriter
description:
If your idea of strategy is a content calendar with generic captions, this isn't for you. We need someone who can think like a growth marketer, write like a copywriter, and execute like someone who's tired of overthinking and just wants to ship good work — fast.

You'll own content and copy across multiple client brands (real estate, fintech, edtech, healthcare, interiors), which means you'll switch tone and strategy depending on who you're writing for — without losing your voice.

What You'll Actually Do

**1\. Strategy \& Content That Builds Brands**

* Build content pillars based on audience psychology — not what's "trending on templates"
* Adapt formats and trends fast, across very different industries
* Plan content that's designed to convert, not just get likes

**2\. Copy That Works Everywhere**

* Write for reels, carousels, landing pages, ads, emailers, WhatsApp campaigns, and brochures
* Craft hooks and captions with actual storytelling — not filler text
* Write Meta Ads copy (headlines, primary text, CTAs) and test variants that convert
* Translate boring offerings into copy people actually want to read

**3\. Trend Execution, Not Trend Watching**

* Spot a trend, adapt it for a client's industry, and execute within 24–48 hours
* Shoot, edit, write, publish — you're not waiting on five approvals to move

**4\. Automation \& Funnels (this matters)**

* Set up ManyChat flows for Instagram/Facebook DM automation
* Build comment → DM → lead capture → conversion funnels
* Segment audiences and write follow\-up sequences that don't sound like a bot

**5\. Data, Not Vanity Metrics**

* Track watch time, retention, shares, and conversions — not just likes
* Use data to kill weak hooks and double down on what's working

You're a Strong Fit If You Have

* 2\+ years writing and strategizing for social media (agency experience is a big plus)
* Real, provable experience adapting content across industries — not just one niche
* Hands\-on experience with ManyChat or similar DM automation tools
* A strong grip on hooks, storytelling, and conversion psychology
* The ability to write trust\-led copy for fintech *and* aspirational copy for real estate — in the same week
* A "test it, don't debate it" execution mindset

Bonus Points

* Basic video editing / content shooting skills
* Understanding of paid \+ organic synergy
* Comfortable using AI writing tools without sounding like one
* Experience with Canva/Adobe, scheduling tools, or basic SEO

What We're Done With

* People who only schedule posts and call it strategy
* Writers who sound the same across every client
* Trend\-followers with no strategic reasoning behind the follow
* "I'll get to testing later" energy

What Success Looks Like

* Content and copy that drives DMs, leads, and actual revenue
* A consistent, recognizable voice across every client — even when the industries are nothing alike
* Automated funnels quietly converting engagement while you sleep
* You becoming the person clients specifically ask for

description:
### **Responsibilities**


**Talent \& Culture**

* To establish an excellent internal communication system through regular and transparent communication as well as cross\-functional collaboration to maximize synergies.

* Develops effective best practice work and business procedures for Adani Group
* Collaborates with executive leadership to define the organization's long\-term mission and goals, identifying ways to support this mission through talent management.
* Identifies and executes key performance indicators for the organization on commercial, operations, finance, human resource, etc. to ensure relevant KPIs are executed and reviewed on a quarterly basis.
* Understanding of operational departments \[Guest Services, Facilities Management, Housekeeping, Culinary, Food \& Beverage, Customer Engagement, Quality Assurance, etc.] and work with country and local leadership to ensure it is functioning in line with the standards set by partners and HQ.
* Ensures corporate policies and procedures are being utilized and recommends improvements.
* Drives the overall business using technology to improve efficiency and achieve maximum operational efficiencies including but not limited to automation and optimization.
* Leads the City or Country in the event of a Crisis working closely with HQ.
* Actively participates in addressing internal and external audit findings by working with relevant stakeholders and taking necessary corrective action promptly.
* Lead the Executive Committee \[ExCom] and hold meetings at least once a month by focusing on the company’s overall priorities and goals from a City and Country level.
* ExCom must define specific strategic plans and actions that will be undertaken to drive and increase revenue, profit, productivity, market share, staff development, technology and attach them to measurable KPIs. The minutes of ExCom meetings will be shared between the leadership Steering Committee members.


**Revenue, Growth and Profit Maximization**


* Sets comprehensive goals for department performance and growth
* Liaises with Commercial Leadership to develop and execute commercial strategies in each location.
* Directly accountable for driving the budget and forecast by implementing a commercial strategy and business plan through execution, utilizing all available business tools and intelligence.
* Ensures the delivery of budgeted revenues across all revenue streams.
* Utilizes Business Intelligence tools to analyze data and performance, providing actionable information for making informed business decisions.
* Optimizes manpower costs by analyzing trends and costs, setting systemic standards for teams to follow, and tracking the results of planned efforts.
* Prepares the annual business plan and budgets including but not limited to manpower, etc.
* Works with the various airport General Managers, Assistant General Managers, Finance PIC, Human Resources PIC including Operations PIC to ensure profits are maximized in line with budgeted revenue and profit targets set.
* Ensures regular business reviews are conducted with all relevant stakeholders, including pricing and rate strategies are in place to achieve positive business results.


**Pre – Opening**


* Drives collaboration across all departments and stakeholders to ensure pre\-opening, refurbishment, or delisting projects are opened or closed within the set time frame.
* Communicate with the Project Team and Project Manager for the project completion timeline.
* Review the Pre\-Opening critical path to schedule key project milestones, work streams, and activities.
* Manage and approve resources requirements for pre\-opening as needed.
* Communicate and liaise with leadership to define project priorities and implementation opportunities and challenges and keep them up to date with project risks and opportunities.
* Ensure company standards are reflected in the projects in terms of Marketing, Branding, IT, F\&B, HR requirements/standards.


**Financial and Commercial Acumen**


* Supports the country finance teams with clear guidelines, responsibilities and ways of working that benefit the Corporate, Shared Services and Country\-Level Finance team
* Reviews, monitors and analyses financial performance in collaboration with the Country Finance against established goals and benchmarks by managing relevant revenue workstreams including driving cost efficiency and savings without impacting customer or brand experience.
* Supports the collection of accounts receivable by collaborating with respective Country Finance and Commercial teams, including HQ and other stakeholders.
* Conducts necessary monthly meetings covering commercial and revenue management strategies, credit collection, operational, strategic planning and execution, etc.
* Manages underperforming or loss\-making outlets, developing short\-to\-long action plans for each business unit to restore profitability.


**Business Development**


* Represents the business units in presentations to the Investment Committee, Steering Committee, and other relevant entities as necessary.
* Forges strategic partnerships and relationships with clients, vendors, agencies, venue partners, and all other professional business relationships.
* Be a key stakeholder collaborating with the legal team on contract management, including but not limited to contributing to the development of effective and efficient contract terms and conditions.
* Growth Management aggressively promotes the business unit maximizing its utilization and negotiating lease agreements as determined necessary and in the best interest of the company.
* Conducts frequent sales and calls with clients to stay updated on the business status and trends.
* Develops and maintains strong relationships with all internal and external stakeholders including but not limited to airport authorities, owners, business units, etc.
* Develops and aligns with Country and HQ business development teams on strategic plans for expansion and growth of the country’s business
* Works with business development and finance stakeholders to analyze ROI for capital projects before committing funds and assesses if anticipated results were achieved upon completion.
* Works with various stakeholders to provide efficient and accurate assessments on project leads and opportunities including inherent risk in the event of underperformance or early termination.
* Proposes relevant new concepts and designs to various stakeholders for review and consideration with the objective to expand and grow the business through quality product differentiation.

### **Qualifications**


* Degree or relevant qualification in a relevant field to the role.
* 15–20 years of progressive industry experience across business development, revenue generation, P\&L management, and operations, with a proven track record of driving business growth and operational excellence.
* Minimum 15\+ years in a senior management role within the Travel, Airline or Hospitality Industry.
* A mix of experience from management to operations of Airports, Hotels, F\&B and/or Travel industry.
* Proven prior experience in a leadership role with analytical, strategic and tactical decisions making including evaluating and identifying business opportunities.
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience presenting financial, commercial and operational plans.
* Working experience in various countries and regions would be an advantage.
* Strong and proven leadership skills with an emphasis on leading, engaging, recognizing, developing and mentoring employees.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, handle pressure, and establish clear expectations.
* Experience working in a collaborative and hierarchal environment.
* Fluent in written and spoken English as well as other key languages.

**Customer Service and Grievance Resolution:**


* Actively listen to customer feedback, address grievances promptly, and work with retailers to resolve issues on the floor.
* Ensure that service providers are consistently meeting quality standards by monitoring daily operations.

**Compliance and Quality Assurance:**


* Ensure retailers adhere to product quality standards, including compliance with MRP regulations and issuance of bills for every transaction.

**Retail Compliance and Quality Monitoring:**


* Ensure retailers are adhering to product quality standards on a daily basis.

**Merchandise Stock and Layout Support:**

**Sales Monitoring and Reporting Support:**


* Assist in monitoring daily sales performance and track progress toward achieving targets.

**Data Collection and Reporting Assistance:**


* Collect and maintain data related to sales, customer trends, and stock levels from different retail outlets.
* Help prepare simple reports based on collected data, highlighting key trends and areas for improvement.
* Track inventory levels and assist in identifying items with low stock or high sales potential.
* Update inventory management systems with real\-time data and report any stock discrepancies.


**Retailer Coordination and Operational Support:**


* Serve as a point of contact for retailers, ensuring they receive the support they need in day\-to\-day operations.
* Coordinate with retailers to resolve minor operational issues promptly, ensuring minimal disruption.
* Communicate with the operations department to fulfill retailer requests and address any operational concerns.

### **Qualifications**


**Education Qualification:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Marketing, or a related field.
* Certifications in Retail Management, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).


**Work Experience:**


* Minimum 8 years of experience in retail sales and customer service, preferably within the airport retail sector.

title: PPC Expert
description:
PPC \& Performance Marketing Manager

**Company:** The Premium Basket  
**Location:** Ambernath, Maharashtra  
**Work Mode:** On\-site  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Industry:** FMCG / D2C / E\-commerce

About The Premium Basket

The Premium Basket is a premium FMCG brand specializing in dry fruits, nuts, nut butters, foxnuts, seasoned nuts, mixed nuts, dates, dragees, and premium gifting solutions.

We are looking for a **PPC \& Performance Marketing Manager** who can take ownership of our paid advertising ecosystem and drive measurable growth across marketplaces and digital channels.

Key Responsibilities1\. Amazon PPC

* Plan, launch, and manage Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.
* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Build and manage **Auto, Manual, Broad, Phrase, and Exact** campaigns.
* Optimize bids, budgets, placements, keywords, search terms, and targeting.
* Monitor **ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPC, impressions, and sales**.
* Identify high\-performing keywords and scale them effectively.
* Identify wastage and reduce spend on non\-performing keywords.
* Manage product targeting and competitor ASIN targeting.
* Develop PPC strategies for **new product launches**.
* Coordinate with the marketplace/e\-commerce team to improve listing conversion.

2\. Google Ads

* Plan and manage Google Search, Shopping/PMax, Display, YouTube, and remarketing campaigns.
* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Develop campaigns based on product categories, customer intent, and commercial objectives.
* Optimize campaigns for **ROAS, conversions, CAC, CPC, and revenue**.
* Manage remarketing and audience campaigns.
* Track campaign performance and continuously improve efficiency.

3\. Meta Ads

* Plan and manage Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.
* Manage prospecting, retargeting, catalog, and conversion campaigns.
* Test different creatives, audiences, offers, and messaging.
* Analyze campaign\-level and creative\-level performance.
* Work closely with the creative team to develop performance\-focused ad creatives.

4\. Performance \& Conversion Optimization

* Monitor the complete advertising funnel from **impression → click → product page → add to cart → purchase**.
* Identify reasons for poor campaign or product performance.
* Work with the content, design, marketplace, and e\-commerce teams to improve conversion rates.
* Recommend improvements to product listings, creatives, landing pages, offers, pricing, and promotions based on advertising data.

5\. Budget \& Growth Management

* Manage monthly advertising budgets and allocate spends across platforms.
* Scale high\-performing campaigns while maintaining profitability.
* Create channel\-wise and product\-wise performance targets.
* Forecast sales and advertising requirements.
* Maintain a healthy balance between **growth, ROAS, ACOS/TACOS, and profitability**.

6\. Analytics \& Reporting

* Prepare weekly and monthly PPC performance reports.
* Track:
* ROAS
* ACOS / TACOS
* CAC
* CTR
* CPC
* Conversion Rate
* Impressions
* Clicks
* Advertising Sales
* Organic Sales
* Total Revenue
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to management.
* Maintain dashboards and performance trackers.

Required Skills

* Strong understanding of **Amazon PPC**
* Google Ads expertise
* Meta Ads expertise
* Keyword research and search\-term analysis
* Campaign structuring and optimization
* Bid and budget management
* Competitor research
* Performance analytics
* Excel / Google Sheets
* Strong numerical and analytical ability
* Understanding of e\-commerce conversion funnels
* Ability to interpret advertising data and take independent decisions

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* FMCG
* D2C brands
* Food \& Beverage
* Dry Fruits / Nuts / Health Foods
* E\-commerce
* Amazon Seller Central
* Quick Commerce
* Shopify
* Consumer brands

Experience managing **Amazon India advertising** is highly preferred.

KPIs

The candidate will be evaluated on:

* Revenue generated through paid advertising
* ROAS improvement
* ACOS/TACOS optimization
* Reduction in wasted ad spend
* Conversion rate improvement
* Customer acquisition cost
* Growth in new customers
* Product\-level sales growth
* Successful new product launches
* Overall advertising profitability

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is **data\-driven, commercially minded, and hands\-on**.

The ideal candidate should not simply report that an ad campaign is performing poorly. They should be able to identify **why it is underperforming, what needs to change, execute the changes, and measure the result.**

A strong understanding of FMCG/e\-commerce buying behaviour and the ability to work closely with creative and marketplace teams will be an advantage.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce, or a related field preferred.

**Relevant hands\-on PPC experience is more important than the degree.**
